tank_description: A heavy attacker, and a slow one at that. The M60A2 is no slouch in the firepower department. A howitzer capable of firing either tank rounds or missiles and backed up by auto-cannons gives the M60A2 rapid damage output capable of overwhelming opposition quickly.

strengths.title: Exceptional Burst Damage
strengths.description: The M60A2 features a powerful opening tool to most engagements. The combination of the howitzer, twin auto-cannons, and guided missile allows it to unleash some of the highest burst damage in the game. Coupled with some later upgrades capable of applying status effects, The M60A2 a very powerful opener to most fights.

strengths.title: Good HP Pool
strengths.description: The M60A2 is on the heavier side of attackers when it comes to its HP. Sitting alongside the ALVT in this metric. This allows the M60A2 the freedom to aggressively push close encounters without commanders having to watch every hit-point closely.

weaknesses.title: Poor Top Speed
weaknesses.description: The M60A2 sits alone at the bottom when it comes to speed. At a stock top forward speed of only 49km/h players will have a hard time keeping up with the flow of a fast moving battle. As a result, measured positioning and Reading the flow of the battle is crucial for getting the most out of the tank.

weaknesses.title: Long Reload
weaknesses.description: At 7 seconds, the M60A2 has a lengthy reload cycle between shots creating exploitable windows where its primary source of damage is unavailable. Switched on commanders may take advantage of the gap in firepower. Especially if the M60A2's auto-cannons are on cooldown.

weaknesses.title: Weak Armour Protection
weaknesses.description: Despite its large HP pool, The M60A2's armour offers little real protection against most weapons it will encounter. It also lacks any form of shields or sacrificial armour. Coupled with large critical zones, concentrated fire will quickly whittle down the HP pool.

tank_summary: The M60A2 is a heavy attacker that trades mobility for overwhelming firepower. Sharing the slowest top speed in the game with the FV4030, it struggles to quickly reposition or react to changing battlefield conditions. However, with a healthy 2,680 hit point pool it can assume the role of an off-tank at the front of battles, adding vital DPM to the team lineup in engagements.

Its primary weapon is a devastating howitzer capable of dealing significant damage with every shot, especially when upgraded with HEAT ammo. Supporting this are a pair of auto-cannons and a guided missile, giving the M60A2 an impressive arsenal that can rapidly overwhelm opponents when all systems are brought to bear. Few vehicles can match its burst damage potential at close range.

One of the M60A2's biggest drawbacks is it's lengthy reload cycle, taking a whole 7 seconds per shot. While the auto-cannons help maintain pressure during the main gun's reload, they will not always be available. Switched on enemies may exploit this knowledge. Also, Despite its respectable hit point pool, its armour is weak and lacking any sacrificial protection. As a result, incoming damage will not be mitigated, eating into that HP pool quickly.
